name: Newhaven, Weapons Shop
desc1: This dusky old shop carries a small assortment of weapons suitable for
desc2: the young adventurer. Torches line the walls, illuminating the room
desc3: with a smoky, flickering glow. A stocky, mustached man stands behind
desc4: a counter here, waiting to provide weaponry to novice adventurers. You
desc5: can exit the shop through a doorway to the south.
